name: Cha bo
summary: Chả bò is a Da Nang beef sausage on the 16 Apr 2024 city page, which says the local method is the reason it is known. The page does not list the grind. The 12 Jun 2026 markets page names it among the specialty goods at Han Market.
origin: Da Nang, on those two city pages. A recipe was not printed.
howToEat: The 2024 page does not describe a method. At Han Market it is one of the goods to take home, beside a bowl of bún chả cá if you are eating in the hall. Check on arrival.
where: Han Market, 119 Trần Phú, on the 12 Jun 2026 page, which prints 06:00–19:00. The 9 Oct 2023 markets page printed the same clock. The 28 Sep 2024 market page did not restate it.
seoTitle: Cha bo — Da Nang beef sausage
seoDescription: Chả bò is a Da Nang beef sausage sold among Han Market’s specialty goods. The city page does not list the grind. The price is Check on arrival.
